[LADP.8.5.1] A service declaration's kwarg modifiers ([LGRA.23.1]) constrain
every `call` to that service:

| Modifier | The compiler must |
|---|---|
| `required` | reject a call that omits the kwarg (`DS_VALIDATE_MISSING_KWARG`) |
| `literal` | reject a call that supplies the kwarg as anything but a literal ([LGRA.10.7], `DS_VALIDATE_DYNAMIC_IDENT_KWARG`) |
| `default <literal>` | lower a call that omits the kwarg exactly as if it supplied the literal, so the service receives it; such a kwarg is never missing |

A kwarg with none of the three is optional and may be computed. The modifiers
travel in the artefact's service manifest (`proto/service_def.proto#ServiceKwarg`).
